{{Alo inversion}}Our Eternal Spouse is an [[epithet]] used to refer to [[Underseer]]. It contrasts with [[Our Greatest Brother|Our Eternal Sibling]] which is for [[Underseer]].

Underseer is a spouse because one's spouse is the most foreign family member, the spouse brings in new information and genetics to the family that allow for the family to transform
